items.caption: Lesser Seal form of 言, the speech-related component in the traditional analysis of 誰.
items.alt: Black seal-script strokes forming 言 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: Shows the component associated with speech meaning in the traditional analysis; this is a modern redraw, not a reported bronze form.

items.caption: Lesser Seal form of 隹, assigned a sound role in the traditional analysis of 誰.
items.alt: Black seal-script strokes forming 隹 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: Shows the component assigned a phonetic role in the traditional analysis, but does not establish that role or the proposed ancient sound connection.

limitations.text: These seal-script component forms do not show the reported bronze graph combining 言 and 隹 or the inscription read with bare 隹 as 誰. No verified image of those bronze forms is available here to illustrate their shapes or relationship directly.
